purpose: Prepare a fail-closed digest-only intake for completed human-controlled DSR and incident-response exercise records so future independent reviewers can validate them without owner identity leakage or automatic gate promotion.

stage69_session_candidate.rule: Must be the digest-only Stage69 session candidate generated only after real assigned owners and assignment artifacts were supplied externally.

completed_exercise_record.rule: Must document actual human execution of all eight bound synthetic scenarios and contain no real customer data or production secrets.

independent_review_record.rule: Must be produced by a real reviewer distinct from automated CI and must address the required DSR and incident coverage.

reviewer_assignment_or_authority_artifac.rule: Must provide a traceable reviewer-authority artifact. The Stage91 output stores only its SHA-256, never the reviewer identity or file path.

dsr: deletion versus retention-hold decision handoff without inventing law or deadlines
incident: credential compromise without real secrets/provider calls
potentially sensitive student data with minimization and legal decision handoff

dsr: owner and backup assignment structurally supported by Stage69 session candidate
deletion/anonymization/blocking versus retention-hold decision path exercised
controller/operator handoff observed or explicitly recorded as unresolved
response-time policy dependency not invented by exercise tooling
tabletop used synthetic or non-customer fixtures only
incident: incident commander, privacy owner and technical owner assignment structurally supported by Stage69 session candidate
risk classification decision path exercised without automated legal conclusion
ANPD/data-subject communication decision remained human/legal authority
all three required incident scenarios executed using synthetic/non-customer fixtures
postmortem findings and remediation follow-up recorded

next_after_green.safe_internal_work: When real Stage69 owner-bound session, completed exercise and independent review records exist, run the Stage91 digest-only collector outside repository CI. Then independently inspect the source artifacts before any Stage44/45 evidence candidate is prepared.
